label: Answer
blurb: Think and reply. No repo, no web, no shell — the fastest harness there is.
_note: The floor of the fleet. Measured 2026-08-10: pi + read + hermit's six = ~3.0k standing tokens, against 22.1k for the omp default (docs/01-measurements.md).
`read` is the one built-in kept. A question that names a file is common enough that losing it costs a whole extra routing hop, and one tool schema is ~300 tokens.
No bash on purpose: the moment a task needs to RUN something it is not this harness's task, and the router should have sent it to shell or patch.
